mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_record (receipt_id, approval_level, approver_role, approver_id, approver_name, status, comment, approval_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{receiptId}, #{approvalLevel}, #{approverRole}, #{approverId}, #{approverName}, #{status}, #{comment}, #{approvalTime}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_record SET approver_role = #{approverRole}, approver_id = #{approverId}, approver_name = #{approverName}, status = #{status}, comment = #{comment}, approval_time = #{approvalTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM approval_record WHERE receipt_id = #{receiptId} ORDER BY approval_level ASC, approval_time ASC
SELECT * FROM approval_record WHERE approval_level = #{approvalLevel} ORDER BY approval_time DESC
SELECT * FROM approval_record WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY approval_time DESC
SELECT * FROM approval_record ORDER BY approval_time DESC
SELECT * FROM approval_record WHERE receipt_id = #{receiptId} ORDER BY approval_level DESC, approval_time DESC LIMIT 1
